segments.video_title: Countermovement jump assessment in a multi-sport high-performance environment
segments.speaker: Taichi Yamashita
segments.title: Introducción a la evaluación del salto con contramovimiento (CMJ) en entornos multideporte
segments.summary: Taichi Yamashita presenta su rol como investigador en el Japan Institute of Sports Sciences. Su objetivo es compartir consideraciones teóricas y basadas en evidencia sobre cómo utilizan el test CMJ en un entorno de alto rendimiento, apoyando a más de 1000 atletas olímpicos y paralímpicos de más de 50 deportes.
segments.literal_quote: Today, I will talk about countermovement jump assessment in a multi-sport high-performance environment.
segments.full_transcript: Hello everyone, and thank you very much for the opportunity to speak in this program. My name is Taichi Yamashita, and I work as a senior researcher at the Japan Institute of Sports Sciences within the Japan High Performance Sports Center in Japan. Today, I will talk about countermovement jump assessment in a multi-sport high-performance environment. In this lecture, I would like to share my perspective as a researcher working with Olympic and Paralympic athletes. My goal is to provide evidence-informed and theory-informed considerations. We support athletes, more than 50 sports, with more than 1,000 athletes each year. So I will also share how we actually use CMJ testing in this type of multi-sport applied setting.
